Pope John XXIII died in the **Apostolic Palace** in **Vatican City** on **June 3, 1963**.

The **Governor** (head of state and government) of Vatican City is the **Pope** himself. Since the author (Pope John XXIII) *was* the Governor of the place of his death at the time of his passing, the question asks for the date his governorship/tenure ended due to his death.

The Governor of the place of death (Vatican City, occupied by Pope John XXIII at the time) ended his rule/life on **June 3, 1963**.

Answer: **June 3, 1963**
